The '''2024 New Zealand Men's National League''' was the fourth season of the [[New Zealand National League|National League]] since its restructuring in 2021.<ref name="NZF-021121">{{cite web |title=National League Championship cancelled, new interregional competition announced and Chatham Cup moved to 2022 |url=https://www.nzfootball.co.nz/newsarticle/109383 |website=New Zealand Football}}</ref> 32 clubs compete in the competition, with four qualifying from the [[Northern League (New Zealand)|Northern League]], three qualifying from the [[Central League (New Zealand)|Central League]] and two qualifying from the [[Southern League (New Zealand)|Southern League]] for the National Championship phase.<ref name="phxchamps"/><ref name="NLSystem">{{cite web |title=New National League system |url=https://www.sporty.co.nz/asset/downloadasset?id=3da9f0fa-187f-406d-8e40-e5a936662fcc |website=[[New Zealand Football]] |access-date=3 April 2021}}</ref>
Each team can field a maximum of four foreign players as well as one additional foreign player who has [[Oceania Football Confederation]] nationality.<ref name="breach">{{cite web |title=Two National League clubs found to have breached foreign player regulations |url=https://www.nzfootball.co.nz/newsarticle/102667 |website=[[New Zealand Football]] |access-date=23 April 2021 |archive-date=23 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210423021812/https://www.nzfootball.co.nz/newsarticle/102667 |url-status=dead }}</ref> 
Over the course of the season, each team must also ensure players aged 20 or under account for 10% of available playing minutes.<ref name="under20s">{{cite web |title=National League regulations for U-20 players revised |url=https://www.nzfootball.co.nz/newsarticle/121766 |website=[[New Zealand Football]] |access-date=9 March 2023 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Men's National League Regulations Season 2024 - Article 27: Registration of Players |url=https://www.nrf.org.nz/asset/downloadasset?id=8e94093e-b309-47c0-a9e6-e992fef09f2d |website=[[Northern Region Football]] |access-date=19 January 2024 }}</ref>

The qualifying league fixtures were announced on 1 March 2024. The Northern League started on 22 March 2024<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nzfootball.co.nz/newsarticle/138931?newsfeedId=1275622|title=New Zealand National League preview|website=New Zealand Football|date=21 March 2024|access-date=21 March 2024}}</ref> with the Central and Southern leagues starting the following weekend on 29 and 28 March respectively. The Northern and Central leagues concluded on 31 August 2024 with the Southern League concluding on 1 September 2024.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nzfootball.co.nz/newsarticle/138095?newsfeedId=1252973|title=Fixtures announced for the National League 2024|website=New Zealand Football|date=1 March 2024|access-date=1 March 2024}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sporty.co.nz/asset/downloadasset?id=f0766a9a-f2ae-46a4-8e0a-7bd4c6fb07b0|title=Northern League Fixtures 2024|website=New Zealand Football|date=1 March 2024|access-date=1 March 2024}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.friendsoffootballnz.com/2024/03/01/new-season-fixtures-released-for-northern-central-and-southern-leagues/|title=New season fixtures released for Northern, Central and Southern Leagues|website=friendsoffootballnz.com|date=1 March 2024|access-date=1 March 2024}}</ref>

The week the Northern League started, [[Northern Region Football|NRF]] announced changes to the competition structure for the 2024 season to accommodate [[Auckland FC]].<ref name="2024Changes">{{Cite web|url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/auckland-fc-introduction-of-new-team-impacts-northern-region-football-domestic-competitions/6GMIQ7TVBFHORC6GKHYJERKDVQ/|title=Auckland FC: Introduction of new team impacts Northern Region Football domestic competitions|website=[[New Zealand Herald]]|date=23 March 2024|access-date=24 March 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240324092423/https://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/auckland-fc-introduction-of-new-team-impacts-northern-region-football-domestic-competitions/6GMIQ7TVBFHORC6GKHYJERKDVQ/|archive-date=24 March 2024|url-status=dead}}</ref> Auckland FC will have a reserves team playing in the qualifying and championship phases from next season to fulfil their [[A-League Men]] requirements.<ref name="NLSystem"/> To allow space for Auckland FC, the Northern League will now have a relegation play-off between the 10th place team and the runners up of the [[2024 NRFL Leagues#Championship|2024 NRFL Championship]] for this season only.<ref name="2024Changes"/><ref name="2024 Rules March">{{cite web |url=https://www.nrf.org.nz/asset/downloadasset?id=fb0321b8-db6a-4301-9f12-8fe4c4222b62|title=LOTTO NRFL Regulations 2024: Appendix 1, Article 8 - Declaration of Winner| publisher=[[Northern Region Football]]|access-date=24 March 2024}}</ref>

The championship phase fixtures were announced on 17 September 2024, with the opening games to be played on 28 September 2024.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.sporty.co.nz/asset/downloadasset?id=4d199dfa-7014-4a7d-ba31-7652d2f4d5e7|title=MEN’S NATIONAL LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP 2024| publisher=[[New Zealand Football]]|access-date=17 September 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nzfootball.co.nz/newsarticle/145500?newsfeedId=1275622|title=Fixtures Announced for National League Championship 2024| publisher=[[New Zealand Football]]|access-date=17 September 2024 |date=16 September 2024}}</ref>

====Northern League teams====
Twelve teams are competing in the league – the top ten teams from the previous season and the two teams promoted from the [[2023 NRFL Leagues#Championship|NRFL Championship]]. The promoted teams are [[Tauranga City AFC|Tauranga City]] and [[East Coast Bays AFC|East Coast Bays]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.friendsoffootballnz.com/2023/09/08/title-race-goes-to-the-wire-in-final-round-of-lotto-nrfl-mens-championship/|title=Title race goes to the wire in final round of Lotto NRFL Men’s Championship|website=friendsoffootballnz.com|access-date=13 October 2023}}</ref> It is both Tauranga City's and East Coast Bay's first season in the National League. They replaced [[Takapuna AFC|Takapuna]] (relegated after a two-year Northern League spell) and [[Manukau United FC|Manukau United]] (relegated after a three-year Northern League spell).<ref name="NorthernRel">{{Cite web|url=https://www.friendsoffootballnz.com/2023/09/02/unbeaten-auckland-city-wrap-up-three-peat-of-northern-league-titles/|title=Unbeaten Auckland City wrap up three-peat of Northern League titles|website=friendsoffootballnz.com|access-date=19 January 2024}}</ref>

==== Central League teams ====
Ten teams are competing in the league – the top nine teams from the previous season and the one team promoted from the 2022 play-off between the winners of the [[Central Federation League]] and the [[Capital Premier (New Zealand)|Capital Premier]]. The winner of the play-off was [[Island Bay United]].<ref>{{cite web |date=23 September 2023 |title=RESULTS: The winners, scorers and tables from Saturday’s top matches |url=https://www.friendsoffootballnz.com/2023/09/23/results-the-winners-scorers-and-tables-from-saturdays-top-matches-24/ |website=friendsoffootballnz.com |access-date=7 November 2023}}</ref> This is their first season in the Central League, since New Zealand football's restructuring in 2021. They replaced [[Whanganui Athletic FC|Whanganui Athletic]] (relegated to the Central Federation League after one season in the Central League).

==== Southern League teams ====
Ten teams are competing in the league – nine teams from the previous season and the winner of the Southern League play-offs. The promoted team is the [[University of Canterbury AFC|University of Canterbury]].<ref>{{cite web |date=30 September 2023 |title=UC Football hold nerve in penalty shootout to win promotion to Southern League |url=https://www.friendsoffootballnz.com/2023/09/30/uc-football-hold-nerve-in-penalty-shootout-to-win-promotion-to-southern-league/ |website=friendsoffootballnz.com |access-date=7 November 2023}}</ref> This is their first season in the Southern League. They replaced [[Green Island AFC|Green Island]] (relegated after three seasons in the Southern League).

====Positions by round====
The table lists the positions of teams after each week of matches. To preserve chronological evolvements, any postponed matches are not included in the round at which they were originally scheduled, but added to the full round they were played immediately afterwards. For example, if a match is scheduled for round 3, but then postponed and played between rounds 6 and 7, it is added to the standings for round 6.
